name: H04_corsair_captain_two_captains_buff_each_other_and_the_pirate_twice
note: Corsair Captain is a Pirate itself, so a second Captain on the battlefield gets +1/+1 from the first and the first gets +1/+1 from the second (3/3 each), and P0's other Pirate gets +1/+1 from each of them (4/4). Neither Captain's own static touches itself ('other'). The second Captain's enters trigger makes one Treasure.
